description: Vehicle 1 goes straight through an intersection. Vehicle 2 is traveling in the same direction as Vehicle 1 and starts behind Vehicle 1. Vehicle 3 is traveling in the same direction as Vehicle 1 and starts behind Vehicle 2. Vehicle 4 approaches from the perpendicular road to the right of Vehicle 1’s approach and turns right onto Vehicle 1’s exit road. Vehicle 5 approaches from the opposite direction of Vehicle 1 and turns left. After the merge region, a couple of cones occupies the center of Vehicle 1’s lane, and a pedestrian crosses perpendicularly across the exit road, starting from the side of the road.
